title: Make Source Label larger
body:
On the Source Selection screen some nice photos are shown. The Label next to it is quite small (at least on my S6). Because G4 and G5 are quite similar, I pressed the wrong Photo the first time. Please increase the Font Size of the Label.

From the guy with glasses ;-)

comments.body: Could you long press on the xDrip icon drop on the home page and re-enable the source wizard just to take a screenshot so I can see if it is looking different on your phone than the one I used for reference? Thanks.

Sure, me is using an old S6 Edge.
